controls.diagnostic_expected: fresh exact label and optimal set; action change is descriptive, not a correctness shortcut
controls.nuisance_expected: same exact label and action; palette/border only

denominators.mean_regret_all: all completed attempts, including fallback regret
denominators.optimal_action_accuracy_all: all completed attempts; fallback counts as failure
denominators.valid_action_rate: all planned requests in the completed arm

hard_gates.budget: at most 48 model requests, no retries
hard_gates.constant_action: at least two distinct valid actions across the 12 base contexts
hard_gates.correct_commit_and_probe_A2_A3: at least one correct COMMIT and one correct PROBE in A2 and A3
hard_gates.leakage: zero forbidden evaluator-label terms in prompts/public payloads
hard_gates.valid_each_arm: at least 11 of 12 valid in each completed direct arm

no_tuning: no prompt, parser, threshold, or selection changes after the first model request
